ARHGAP27 (98.4 kDa) is heavier than MPO (83.9 kDa) as a single polypeptide chain.

Note: MPO is synthesized as an 83.9 kDa precursor that is proteolytically processed and assembles into a mature tetramer (two heavy ~59 kDa + two light ~14.5 kDa chains, plus heme), so the biologically active enzyme complex is much larger (~150 kDa) than its UniProt precursor mass. This is not an error but a caveat on what "mass" means for MPO.
